name: India Gate
descriptor: 42-metre sandstone arch war memorial on Rajpath, New Delhi.

identifyingCues.text: single large triumphal arch in sandstone
names of soldiers inscribed on the arch surfaces
Amar Jawan Jyoti eternal flame beneath the arch

identity.text: War memorial designed by Edwin Lutyens to commemorate soldiers of the British Indian Army who died in World War I and the Third Anglo-Afghan War.

visiting.text: Open 24 hours. The surrounding Kartavya Path lawns are a popular evening gathering spot.

conditions.text: Flat urban parkland. Same Delhi climate: extreme heat in summer, monsoon July–September.

context.text: Central to New Delhi's ceremonial axis. The Republic Day parade passes through here every 26 January.
